id.name: ConNF.Enumeration.eq_of_scoderiv_mem
id.content:
theorem eq_of_scoderiv_mem {X : Type _} {α β γ : TypeIndex} (E : Enumeration (β ↝ ⊥ × X))
    (h : β < α) (h' : γ < α)
    (i : κ) (A : γ ↝ ⊥) (x : X) (h : (E ↗ h).rel i ⟨A ↗ h', x⟩) :
    β = γ := by
  rw [scoderiv_rel] at h
  obtain ⟨B, h₁, h₂⟩ := h
  exact Path.scoderiv_index_injective h₁.symm

C1_dependencies.name: ConNF.Path.scoderiv_index_injective
C1_dependencies.content:
theorem Path.scoderiv_index_injective {A : β ↝ δ} {B : γ ↝ δ} {hβα : β < α} {hγα : γ < α}
    (h : A ↗ hβα = B ↗ hγα) :
    β = γ := by
  have := congr_arg rev h
  rw [scoderiv_rev, scoderiv_rev, RevPath.cons.injEq] at this
  exact this.1

/-- Either the base type or a proper type index (an inhabitant of `Λ`).
The base type index is written `⊥`. -/
@[reducible]
def TypeIndex :=
  WithBot Λ
